# Radoslav Radev Requires A Three To Five Second Pike Straddle Planche Hold Before Half Pike

Radoslav Radev says that with a foundation of 15 seconds frog stand, you will hold the pike straddle planche around from three to five seconds. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:35]

## Details

- You need three to five seconds on the pike straddle planche before you move on to half pike. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:35]
- On the pike straddle planche you need between 10 or 15 seconds again before the next step. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:54]
- Let's say you have 15 seconds on pike straddle. You have four times per week to train. Then it is possible to go in one week to three seconds on the next progression. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:59] [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 08:09]
- And if you have 10, 15 seconds on pike, you will be ready to have three seconds on half pike. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 08:23]

## Evidence

- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:35 (Radoslav Radev): "But if you have enough foundation of 15 seconds frog stand, definitely you will hold it around from three to five seconds."
- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:54 (Radoslav Radev): "You need between 10 or 15 seconds again."
- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:59 (Radoslav Radev): "Let's say you have 15 seconds here. You have four times per week to train."
- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 08:09 (Radoslav Radev): "definitely it's possible to go for one week to three seconds because you need just three seconds on the next progression to just to start doing the next progression,"
- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 08:23 (Radoslav Radev): "And if you have 10, 15 seconds on pike, you will be ready to have three seconds on half pike."
